info.title: agentsd
info.description: The methods a host (agentsd) answers, sent to it with `h`. Every method's params are its one `params` value, sent as JSON-RPC's whole params (an object, or for a few a bare value), as DaemonAPI sends them. A method with `x-notification` has no result: the server sends it. The `web` tag marks what the web page calls and hears (DaemonAPI.WebSignatures); a method a Go step ports joins with its types, schema first.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.wire/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: A host says machine/hello with its capabilities on each connect (#1748). The control plane requires it of hosts.

x-declared-capabilities.name: agents.move-worktree/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host serves the app tool move_worktree to the runtimes that can move (#1821): an agent moves into a new or existing worktree of its folder when its turn ends, and back with leave_worktree remove, which removes the worktree once its work is pushed. An app tool, not a method, so declared.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.team/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: A host knows the user it belongs to (#994, #1763). On a control plane with more than one person, a host without it is needsUpdate, and calls to it are answered -32074 updateToJoinTeam (R14).

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.suspend/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host hears user/suspended (#1002, FR-018): it stops its person's running turns, pauses their workflows and queued prompts, refuses new work and the window's direct path, and keeps every agent and file; off: true ends the pause. It keeps the state in <root>/suspended.json. A notification it hears, not a method it serves, so declared.

methods.name: agents/cancelContinue
methods.description: The chat no longer carries on by itself (#1859). Nothing happens when it was not waiting to.

methods.name: agents/continueInNew
methods.description: Continue in New (#999): start a session in the same folder that reads this one and carries on, with its runtime, choices and the person's labels, on another account: the one given, else the runtime's account for new sessions. For a session whose account the organisation removed or no longer allows. Refused with policyRefused when the policy refuses that account.

methods.name: agents/continueWhenBack
methods.description: A chat paused by a spent allowance carries on when the allowance is back (#1859): at the provider's reset time, or the app's next check, or as soon as a turn on that runtime works or the person marks it available. Refused for a chat that is not paused by a spent allowance.

methods.name: agents/move
methods.description: The person moving an agent, or taking back the move that is waiting (053).

methods.name: artifact/write
methods.description: Write a file an agent may read, whole (#415). With `base`, refused with fileChanged when the file changed on disk since the edit began (#1858), so nobody's change is written over unseen.

methods.name: clientPermissions/changed
methods.description: The saved permission modes (061).

methods.name: clientPermissions/set
methods.description: Save the permission modes and return what was saved (061).

methods.name: daemon/policyState
methods.description: The organisation's policy as this machine follows it (#998, T027).

methods.name: daemon/policyStateChanged
methods.description: The policy this machine follows changed, or the kill switch turned (#998).

methods.name: git/fill
methods.description: Asked by the control plane on the lending host's channel 0, for a lend a person allowed (#1122).

methods.name: retention/changed
methods.description: How long archived agents are kept, after a change.

methods.name: retention/set
methods.description: Change how long archived agents are kept. Unconfirmed, a change that would delete agents now is only described.

methods.name: runtimes/setDefaultAccount
methods.description: A runtime's account for new sessions, Reaches the Model By (#999, FR-016): an added account, an org account (org:<route id>) or default for the runtime's own sign-in. Kept on the machine. Refused with policyRefused when the organisation's policy refuses that account.

methods.name: sandbox/changed
methods.description: The saved command-sandbox defaults (064).

methods.name: sandbox/set
methods.description: Save command-sandbox defaults. A default the catalog does not offer for that runtime is dropped. An agent's own choice is left as it is (064).

methods.name: selfUpdate/changed
methods.description: A Mac's host, when how it updates Agents Host changes (#2178).

methods.name: selfUpdate/set
methods.description: A Mac's host: turn updating Agents Host by itself on or off (#2178). Kept in host-update.json in the root.

methods.name: selfUpdate/status
methods.description: A Mac's host: how it updates Agents Host to the release the control plane names (#2178). Only a Mac's host serves it.

methods.name: settings/passThrough
methods.description: The person's own pass-through names, from runtime-environment.json, each marked when the organisation's policy refuses it (#998, FR-011a).

methods.name: settings/userPart
methods.description: A part of the user settings as this machine has it (#1760), for Use This Mac's under You. This machine also writes machine/userSettings into its files.

methods.name: workflows/limit
methods.description: How many workflows may be turned on at once. No total is the default.

methods.name: workflows/setLimit
methods.description: Set how many approved workflows may be turned on in each folder. The value is from 1 to 100. An unset value means 20.
